function.name: get_struct_def
function.description: Retrieve the definition of a struct type, including its line numbers, from the specified source file (.c or .h). The struct_name must be related to src_file: it must be defined, declared, used, or referenced in the specified file. Do not query unrelated struct types.

struct_name.description: The name of the struct type to retrieve. It must appear in or be referenced by src_file.

src_file.description: The source file where struct_name is defined, declared, used, or referenced.
